content_of_post_to_answer: How would you describe human emotions?
answer: Human emotions are not just reactions; they are signals shaped by memory, biology, relationships, and interpretation. The same event can create different emotions in different people because we do not experience reality directly—we experience the meaning our minds assign to it. Emotions are not always accurate descriptions of the world, but they are valuable information about how we are relating to it. The hardest skill is learning to listen to emotions without letting them become the only voice making decisions.
